headline: Approved amendments to Chapter 117-Animals and reappointed Timothy R. Creamer as Constable, both 3-0.
summary: The committee approved proposed amendments to Chapter 117-Animals, Order #058A, adding a new section on feeding wild animals, with changes made during the meeting. The committee also approved the reappointment of Timothy R. Creamer, 36 Appleton Avenue, to serve as Constable, Order #112.
decisions: Approved reappointment of Timothy R. Creamer, 36 Appleton Avenue, as Constable, Order #112, 3-0.
Approved motion to strike section 117-21 from the amendments to Order #058A, 3-0.
Approved motion to accept Solicitor Dole's suggested wording for section A of the amendment, 3-0.
